authority: Metric definitions describe interpretation; official values are calculated by Java.

bugRatio.label: Bug Ratio
bugRatio.interpretation: Higher means more reported bugs relative to user stories.
limitations: Not the percentage of defective stories.
Not a defect severity measure.
Can exceed 100 when bugs exceed stories.
Undefined when totalStories is zero unless Java defines a rule.

defectScore.label: Defect Quality Score
defectScore.interpretation: Lower score indicates weaker quality in the defect dimension under this formula.
limitations: Not the percentage of bugs or critical defects.
Do not infer defect severity or business impact.
Can become negative if bugRatio exceeds 100 unless Java clamps it.

confidence.label: Internal confidence indicator
confidence.interpretation: An application-specific indicator; its computation and meaning must be verified against Java implementation.
limitations: Not independent proof of data reliability, release safety or decision correctness.

riskLevel.label: Official release risk level
riskLevel.interpretation: Use the exact value supplied by Java; do not downgrade or contradict it.
limitations: Do not infer individual defect severity from the overall risk level.

releaseDecision.label: Official release decision
releaseDecision.interpretation: Use the exact decision supplied by Java and describe the residual risks.
limitations: GO_WITH_RISK does not mean that the release is proven safe or that risk acceptance is documented.

totalBugs.label: Reported bug count
totalBugs.interpretation: Reported total bug count used by the relevant QA metric.
limitations: Do not equate with Sonar bugs unless data provenance confirms equivalence.

bugs.label: Sonar bug count (when sourced from SonarQube)
bugs.interpretation: Static analysis bug findings; verify provenance of the field.
limitations: Do not automatically add to or equate with totalBugs.

codeSmells.label: Code smells
limitations: Not direct proof of runtime defects or root causes.

uncoveredRequirements.label: Uncovered requirements
uncoveredRequirements.interpretation: Requirements not covered according to the application's coverage mapping.
limitations: Criticality and business impact require separate evidence.

coverageScore.label: Epic Coverage Score
coverageScore.coverageRule: An Epic is covered if it has at least one Story and every Story is Done. An Epic with zero Stories is NOT covered.
limitations: This is Epic-level functional coverage, not Sonar code coverage.
An Epic with any Story not Done is not covered.
Undefined for zero totalEpics unless Java defines a fallback.
Do not automatically equate with requirement coverage unless mappings establish equivalence.

incidentRate.label: Customer Incident Rate
incidentRate.classification: Customer incident is identified through a Jira Summary matching a configured client name (e.g. Cargill, Bunge, Barclays); verify exact matching implementation.
limitations: Classification by Summary text is a heuristic and may miss or misclassify incidents.
Undefined if totalBugs=0 unless Java defines fallback.

incidentScore.label: Incident Quality Score
incidentScore.unit: quality score on a nominal 0–100 scale
limitations: Not direct customer satisfaction.
Uses the same customer-incident classification as incidentRate.

feedbackScore.label: Critical Customer Incident Absence Proxy
feedbackScore.formula: 100 if count(customer incidents with severity BLOCKER or CRITICAL) == 0 else 0
limitations: Does not measure direct customer satisfaction or NPS.
A 100 score means no identified critical/blocker customer incident, not all customers are satisfied.
Depends on customer-incident identification and severity data.

rcaCoverage.label: RCA Coverage
limitations: Undefined for zero customer incidents unless Java defines fallback.

correctiveActionCoverage.label: Corrective Action Coverage
limitations: Undefined for zero RCAs unless Java defines fallback.

preventiveActionCoverage.label: Preventive Action Coverage
limitations: Undefined for zero RCAs unless Java defines fallback.

rcaClosureRate.label: RCA Closure Rate
limitations: Undefined for zero RCAs unless Java defines fallback.

rcaScore.label: RCA Quality Score
limitations: 30/25/25/20 are weights, not observed release percentages.
Do not infer actual effectiveness of corrective actions from coverage alone.

sonarScore.label: Sonar Technical Quality Score
limitations: Subscore conversion thresholds are not specified in the provided diagrams; verify implementation.
Sonar code coverage is displayed separately and NOT included in this Sonar Score.
Technical Sonar bugs are not automatically the same as Jira totalBugs.

businessQis.label: Business Quality Intelligence Score
businessQis.formula: sum((configuredWeight_i / sumConfiguredWeights) * businessScore_i) over coverage, defect, feedback, incident, rca
businessQis.weightsSource: Rule Designer; configurable and normalized by the sum of configured weights
limitations: Business QIS is the normalized weighted average BEFORE the final 80% business contribution.
Do not apply 80% within Business QIS; apply it only in QIS Final.

qisFinal.label: Final Quality Intelligence Score
limitations: Use official Java values rather than slide examples.
Rounded display contributions may differ from full-precision intermediate values.

sourceNotes: Rules transcribed from user-supplied QA metric diagrams (November 2026).
Business QIS is 72.87 BEFORE the final 80% weight; 72.87*0.8 + 75.25*0.2 = 73.35.
Example values are illustrative and must not override official release metrics.
Where denominator is zero or a transformation threshold is unspecified, consult Java implementation.
